tracks.title: The A Side Of The Label Of The Album Of The Soundtrack Of The Trailer Of The Film Of Monty Python And The Holy Grail
The B Side Of The Label Of The Album Of The Soundtrack Of The Trailer Of The Film Of Monty Python And The Holy Grail

verdict.text: Discogs doesn't know when this was pressed

physical: Virgin Records Ltd. Distribution, Made In England

notes.text:
Blue label reissue with 'Distributed by Virgin Records Ltd.' on labels, released in an older sleeve with the Charisma Classics logo.
Unlike the earlier

, this release has different labels, back cover and runouts.

Sleeve states:
Recorded live at the 3:10 showing at The Classic, Silbury Hill.
Featuring:
The Ballad of King Arthur
The Ballad of The Towering Inferno
The Ballad of Herbie Rides Again
The Ballad of Bring Me The Head Of Alfredo Garcia
The Ballad of Sir Kenneth Clark
The Ballad of The Greater London Re-Development Plan for Haringey
WARNING!!! This record can only be played ONCE!

Recorded and produced at Sunrise Music And Recording Ltd.
Additional music by DeWolfe.
Distributed by Virgin Records Ltd.

℗ 1975 Charisma Records Ltd.
